_provenance.source: FAA d-TPP cycle 2610 approach plates (rendered pages data/sources/raw/dtpp_2610_txt/P_*-1.png)
_provenance.method: Each hold depiction was located on the rendered plate, cropped and magnified, and read visually: inbound course = the racetrack leg whose arrowhead points at the fix; turns = side of the inbound track the racetrack is drawn on (racetrack to the right of the inbound track = right turns); leg = printed "N NM" tick or "1 min" label, else default 1 minute (leg_source says which). HUMAN TRANSCRIPTION - verify against the PDFs before any real use.
_provenance.not_included: The (a)(b)(c) entry-sector inset on the ZAPOM plates is an entry diagram, not a separate hold. Dotted missed-approach climbing turns near the runway ends are not holds.
